title: Exploring FAM13A-N-Myc interactions to uncover potential targets in MYCN-amplified neuroblastoma: a study of protein interactions and molecular dynamics simulations.
authors: Yin, Hongli; Liu, Tianyi; Wu, Di; Li, Xiaolu; Li, Gen; Song, Weiwei; Wang, Xiaodong; Xin, Shan; Liu, Yisu; Pan, Jian
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用AlphaFold、GROMACS和分子动力学模拟探索FAM13A与N-Myc蛋白互作，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Neuroblastoma (NB), a common infantile neuroendocrine tumor, presents a substantial therapeutic challenge when MYCN is amplified. Given that the protein structure of N-Myc is disordered, we utilized Alphafold for prediction and GROMACS for optimization of the N-Myc structure, thereby improving the reliability of the predicted structure. The publicly available datasets GSE49710 and GSE73517 were adopted, which contain the transcriptome data of clinical samples from 598 NB patients. Through various machine learning algorithms, FAM13A was identified as a characteristic gene of MYCN. Cell functional experiments, including those on cell proliferation, apoptosis, and cell cycle, also indicate that FAM13A is a potential risk factor. Additionally, Alphafold and GROMACS were employed to predict and optimize the structure of FAM13A. Protein-protein docking and molecular dynamic modeling techniques were then used to validate the enhanced protein stability resulting from the interaction between N-Myc and FAM13A. Consequently, targeting FAM13A holds the potential to reduce the stability of N-Myc, hinder the proliferation of NB cells, and increase the infiltration of immune cells. This multi-faceted approach effectively combats tumor cells, making FAM13A a prospective therapeutic target for MYCN-amplified NB.
abstract_zh: 神经母细胞瘤（Neuroblastoma, NB）是一种常见的婴幼儿神经内分泌肿瘤，当MYCN扩增时，其治疗面临重大挑战。鉴于N-Myc蛋白结构无序，我们利用Alphafold进行预测，并采用GROMACS对N-Myc结构进行优化，从而提高了预测结构的可靠性。采用了公开数据集GSE49710和GSE73517，其中包含598名NB患者临床样本的转录组数据。通过多种机器学习算法，FAM13A被鉴定为MYCN的特征基因。细胞功能实验，包括细胞增殖、凋亡和细胞周期实验，也表明FAM13A是一个潜在的风险因素。此外，使用Alphafold和GROMACS预测并优化了FAM13A的结构。随后，利用蛋白质-蛋白质对接和分子动力学模拟技术验证了N-Myc与FAM13A相互作用所导致的蛋白质稳定性增强。因此，靶向FAM13A有望降低N-Myc的稳定性，抑制NB细胞的增殖，并增加免疫细胞的浸润。这种多方面的策略有效对抗肿瘤细胞，使FAM13A成为MYCN扩增型NB的一个有前景的治疗靶点。
